title: Human or Machine? A Preliminary Turing Test for Speech-to-Speech Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2602.24080v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The pursuit of human-like conversational agents has long been guided by the Turing test. For modern speech-to-speech (S2S) systems, a critical yet unanswered question is whether they can converse like humans. To tackle this, we conduct the first Turing test for S2S systems, collecting 2,968 human judgments on dialogues between 9 state-of-the-art S2S systems and 28 human participants. Our results deliver a clear finding: no existing evaluated S2S system passes the test, revealing a significant gap in human-likeness. To diagnose this failure, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy of 18 human-likeness dimensions and crowd-annotate our collected dialogues accordingly. Our analysis shows that the bottleneck is not semantic understanding but stems from paralinguistic features, emotional expressivity, and conversational persona. Furthermore, we find that off-the-shelf AI models perform unreliably as Turing test judges. In response, we propose

translated_title: 人还是机器？面向语音到语音交互的初步图灵测试
translated_abstract: 对类人对话智能体的追求长期以来一直由图灵测试所指引。对于现代语音到语音（S2S）系统而言，一个关键却尚未解答的问题是：它们能否像人类一样进行对话。为解决这一问题，我们开展了首次针对S2S系统的图灵测试，收集了2,968条人类判断，评判对象为9个最先进的S2S系统与28名人类参与者之间的对话。我们的结果给出了一个明确的发现：没有任何一个被评估的现有S2S系统通过了该测试，这揭示了其在类人程度上存在显著差距。为了诊断这一失败，我们构建了一个包含18个类人性维度的细粒度分类体系，并对收集到的对话进行了相应的众包标注。我们的分析表明，瓶颈并非在于语义理解，而是源自副语言特征、情感表达能力以及对话人格。此外，我们发现现成的AI模型作为图灵测试的评判者表现并不可靠。为此，我们提出（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 首次针对语音到语音系统开展图灵测试，发现现有系统均无法通过，其瓶颈不在于语义理解，而在于副语言特征、情感表达和对话人格。
en_tdlr: We conduct the first Turing test for speech-to-speech systems and find that none of the existing evaluated systems pass, with the bottleneck lying in paralinguistic features, emotional expressivity, and conversational persona rather than semantic understanding.
